title: Probes and the public status page are served without an authentication gate
description: The liveness probe, the readiness probe, and the public status page respond to unauthenticated HTTP requests. No cookie, no header, no source-IP allowlist gates access to these three surfaces. The three paths are declared at boot as auth-exempt in whatever authentication middleware the application uses, and that exemption is the only auth policy the surfaces run under.
rationale: Orchestrators, load balancers, and external status-page readers cannot be expected to hold service credentials. A probe that requires auth is a probe the orchestrator cannot use; a status page that requires auth is not a public status page. The auth-exempt declaration is what makes the exemption an operator-visible policy rather than a piece of implicit middleware ordering.
